correctness.rationale: Commutation with the source twist and the involution equation give exactly 32 degree-zero involutions: 16 diagonal-sign and 16 swap-sign maps. The source eigenspace criterion shows every swap-sign map is product, while exactly two diagonal-sign maps fail because the bracket [e1,e2,e4,e5]=e3 exits an eigenspace. The degree-zero centroid commuting with the twist is KI, so no admissible involution is strict. Direct checking of all 32 maps agrees.

value.rationale: The source uses Example 6.1 as its concrete illustration of strict product structures, so correcting its status is structurally important. The repair does more than negate one claim: it completely solves the involutive product problem on the example, showing 28 ordinary product structures but an empty strict locus and identifying the entire relevant centroid.
